name: Sofitel Angkor Phokeethra Golf and Spa Resort
short_description: A 238-room resort on Charles de Gaulle Avenue, the closest Siem Reap hotel to Angkor Wat, with the city's largest free-form pool and an 18-hole golf course.
ai_summary: Sofitel Angkor Phokeethra Golf and Spa Resort sits in landscaped gardens on Charles de Gaulle Avenue, positioned as the closest Siem Reap hotel to the ruins of Angkor Wat. The 238-room resort features Siem Reap's largest free-form pool, five food and beverage outlets including the acclaimed Mouhot's Dream French restaurant, and access to the Phokeethra Country Club's 18-hole golf course. Guests consistently describe the property as an unforgettable luxury stay, praising the French Colonial design, manicured tropical gardens, and hospitality so strong that some travelers return annually, with the resort's own guests calling it the best hotel they've stayed at anywhere.

faqs.question: How close is Sofitel Angkor Phokeethra to Angkor Wat?
faqs.answer: It's positioned as the closest Siem Reap hotel to the ruins of Angkor Wat, set in landscaped gardens on Charles de Gaulle Avenue, roughly 10 minutes from the temple complex.

faqs.question: Does Sofitel Angkor Phokeethra have a golf course?
faqs.answer: Yes -- guests have access to the Phokeethra Country Club's 18-hole golf course, alongside Siem Reap's largest free-form pool and a full-service spa.

reviews.title: Sofitel Angkor Phokeethra Resort Hotel Review
